args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP, but FIN-212 requires
ROUND_HALF_EVEN. Updated the rounding constant accordingly.

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but FIN-212 requires banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build to fail on `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.

## Change
- Switch rounding constant from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212` passed (sha `08d3cd5986`).
